front.title: A Research Evidence Bundle JSON Envelope for Provenance and Replication Metadata

abstract.t: This document proposes an early-stage JSON envelope for exchanging research-evidence records containing claim status, evidence tier, source provenance, methods, falsifiers, replication status, artifact digests, and privacy review. It is an individual design proposal, not an IETF consensus document. Its intended contribution must be assessed against existing provenance and research-packaging specifications before further standardization work.
